homilies.title: 單-將臨期第四週星期四道理：聖依撒伯爾的德行與若翰的名字
homilies.content:
聖依撒伯爾是一位德行高尚的婦女。因為對一位婦女而言，最重要的是能夠生育，而不是不孕。但天主為麗莎安排了一個特別的計畫。她的不孕並不是因為天主在懲罰她，而是天主在幫助她磨練德行。

到了第八天，他們來給孩子行割損禮，原想給他起名叫匝加利亞。為什麼是在行割損禮之後才給孩子命名呢？

因為除非人先捨棄肉身的私慾——這正是割損禮所象徵的——否則就不配使自己的名字被記在生命冊上。

天主沒有給他起名叫匝加利亞，是因為「匝加利亞」意指「記念天主」，而「若翰」意指「指出」。記念涉及不在眼前的事物，指出則涉及在眼前的事物。但若翰不是要使人記念一位不在眼前的天主；正如聖經所說，若翰將要宣告：「看，天主的羔羊！」

我們的主說：好樹不結壞果子，壞樹也不結好果子。好樹和壞樹都會結果子，但只有義人的果實，才能為他人發出光明，就如今天的聖依撒伯爾一樣。

義人與作惡的人都必須忍受磨難。然而，天主考驗義人，是為使他們更加聖善，從而獲得天上的賞報；作惡的人則受到提醒，不要再犯罪。若他們不悔改，就會走向永罰之地。

願聖母幫助我們，時常按照正直的良心行事，並常常向上主祈求智慧。

en.title: Odd-Thursday of the Fourth Week of Advent: St. Elizabeth’s Virtue and the Name of John
en.content:
St. Elizabeth is a woman of great virtue. For the most important thing for a woman is to be fruitful, not barren. But God had a special plan for Lisa. Her infertility was not because God was punishing her, but because God was helping her to sharpen her virtue.

Now on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; they were going to call him Zechariah.Why was the name given after the circumcise?

because no man except he first cast aside his fleshly lusts, which circumcision signifies, is worthy to have his name written in the book of life.

The reason why God did not give him the name Zacharias becouse Zacharias means is “remembering God,” and John means is “pointing to.” Now “memory” relates to something absent, “pointing to,” to something present. But John was not about to set forth the memory of God as absent, As the Bible says, John would say: Behold the Lamb of God.

Our lord said:a good tree does not bear bad fruit; a bad tree does not bear good fruit. Both good and bad trees bear fruit. But it is only the fruit of the righteous that shines for others, just as it does for the St. Elizabeth today.

Both the righteous and the evildoers must endure, but God tests the righteous in order to make them more holy and thus earn the rewards of heaven; but the evildoers are reminded not to sin again, and if they do not repent, they will go to the place of eternal punishment.

May Our Lady help us always to act in right conscience and always to ask the Lord for wisdom.

homilies.title: 單-將臨期第四週星期六早上道理：天主的慷慨與達味的忠信
homilies.content:
誰能明白天主的心意？我們能理解一位慷慨的天主嗎？有時候，天主知道我們的善意，我們也願意向祂奉獻外在美好的事物，祂卻不接受。相反地，祂願意賜給我們更多、更豐盛的恩惠。

為什麼呢？因為天主的慷慨，總是遠遠超過人的慷慨。我們付出自己的辛勞，例如祈禱、努力工作、奉獻工資。我們看似有所損失，卻獲得更多健康、恩惠、家庭的平安、內心的平安等等。

這一切正如耶穌所說：你們給，也就給你們，並且用十足的升斗，連按帶搖，以致外溢，倒在你們的懷裏；因為你們用什麼升斗量，也用什麼升斗量給你們。

在今天的讀經中，達味住進自己的宮殿，上主使他安享太平，不再受到四周仇敵的侵擾。納堂對君王說：「你心中打算的，你全可照辦，因為上主與你同在。」

但結果卻出乎達味的意料。天主要達味奉獻的，並不是聖殿，而是達味對祂的忠信。正因為他對天主忠信，他才獲得了天下，而天主也喜悅他的作為。

對一位父親而言，他需要子女給他什麼呢？

無非就是愛。看見自己的孩子成長，並努力為他做許多事，我們美善的上主就滿足了。

因此，我們知道，因著達味的請求，天主使最偉大的君王從他的後裔中誕生，就是基督，永恆的和平之王。祂的仁慈與偉大，使我們能永遠信賴祂；沒有別的神比基督更了解人。

願聖母引領我們走向慈悲的天父，使我們全心接受祂唯一聖子的教導。

en.title: Odd-Saturday Morning of the Fourth Week of Advent: God’s Generosity and David’s Faithfulness
en.content:
Who can understand the mind of God? Or can we understand a generous God?Or sometimes God knows our good intentions, and we are willing to offer Him outwardly good things, but He does not accept them. Instead, he wants to give us more and more abundant favors

Why? Because of God's generosity, which is always far greater than that of man. We give of our hard work. For example: prayer, hard work, wages. We seem to lose, but we do gain more health, favour, family peace, inner peace, etc.

And all this as Jesus said:Give, and there will be gifts for you: a full measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be poured into your lap; because the amount you measure out is the amount you will be given back.’

In today's reading, :Once David had settled into his house and the Lord had given him rest from all the enemies surrounding him, Nathan said to the king, ‘Go and do all that is in your mind, for the Lord is with you.’

But the result was unexpected for David. For it was not the temple that God wanted David to give him. Rather, it was the faithfulness of David to him. It is because of his faithfulness to God that he got the world. And God was pleased with his work.

For a father, what does he need from his children?

It is nothing but love. He sees his child grow and try to do a lot for him, and our good Lord is satisfied.

As a result, we know that because of the request of David, God has given birth to the greatest of kings from his offspring. That is Christ, the eternal King of Peace. His mercy, his greatness, is such that we can trust him forever, and there is no other God more understanding of people than Christ.

May Our Lady lead us to the Merciful Father and accept with all our hearts the teachings of His only Son.
